question: Will AI be the #1 crypto narrative by Kaito mindshare for the week of Aug 18–22, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the "AI" narrative holds the #1 rank by mindshare among all crypto narratives on Kaito's narrative mindshare leaderboard for the weekly period ending at the market's settlement time.
- "No": Wins if any narrative other than "AI" holds the #1 rank by mindshare on Kaito's narrative mindshare leaderboard for the weekly period ending at the market's settlement time.

Clarifications:
- "This week" refers to the 7-day (WTD) mindshare ranking on Kaito's narrative leaderboard as measured at or nearest to the market's settlement time. If Kaito labels the narrative differently (e.g., "Artificial Intelligence"), it still qualifies as "AI" for this market provided it is the principal AI-themed narrative category.
